summary: PLAT-103: validateApp now throws if owner missing/empty; shared-contracts bumped 1.0.0->2.0.0 (breaking). core-shell (platform), billing (payments) and reports (insights, not in ticket but would have broken) pass owner from package.json team. Assumptions: shared-contracts is an in-repo lib inlined at build time, so no registry publish/dependency update applies; owners hardcoded as strings since bundles can't read package.json; one PR since all changes must land together. CI and CD green.
